title: HydroShear: Hydroelastic Shear Simulation for Tactile Sim-to-Real Reinforcement Learning
abstract: arXiv:2603.00446v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: In this paper, we address the problem of tactile sim-to-real policy transfer for contact-rich tasks. Existing methods primarily focus on vision-based sensors and emphasize image rendering quality while providing overly simplistic models of force and shear. Consequently, these models exhibit a large sim-to-real gap for many dexterous tasks. Here, we present HydroShear, a non-holonomic hydroelastic tactile simulator that advances the state-of-the-art by modeling: a) stick-slip transitions, b) path-dependent force and shear build up, and c) full SE(3) object-sensor interactions. HydroShear extends hydroelastic contact models using Signed Distance Functions (SDFs) to track the displacements of the on-surface points of an indenter during physical interaction with the sensor membrane. translated_title: HydroShear：面向触觉仿真到真实强化学习的水弹性剪切仿真
translated_abstract: 本文研究了面向接触丰富任务的触觉仿真到真实策略迁移问题。现有方法主要集中于基于视觉的传感器，强调图像渲染质量，而对力和剪切却提供了过于简化的模型。因此，这些模型在许多灵巧操作任务中存在较大的仿真到真实的差距。本文提出了HydroShear，一个非完整约束的水弹性触觉仿真器，它通过建模以下内容推进了该领域的最新技术水平：a）粘滑转变，b）路径依赖的力和剪切累积，以及c）完整的SE(3)物体-传感器交互。HydroShear利用带符号距离函数（SDF）扩展了水弹性接触模型，以在压头与传感器膜物理交互过程中跟踪压头表面点的位移。我们的方法能够从任意水密几何体生成基于物理的、计算高效的力场，同时保持对底层……（原文截断）
tldr: HydroShear是一个基于水弹性接触模型与符号距离函数的非完整触觉仿真器，通过建模粘滑转变、路径依赖的力与剪切累积以及完整SE(3)物体-传感器交互，显著缩小了接触丰富任务中触觉策略的仿真到真实差距。
en_tdlr: HydroShear is a non-holonomic hydroelastic tactile simulator that narrows the sim-to-real gap for contact-rich tactile reinforcement learning by modeling stick-slip transitions, path-dependent force and shear build-up, and full SE(3) object-sensor interactions using signed distance functions.
